caption:
Working harder on the wrong thing is still the wrong thing. Effort is not the constraint.

first_comment: Every call comes with what would prove it wrong attached. If that test fails, the call was wrong.
alt_text: Poster reading: Busy is not the same as blocked. Working harder on the wrong thing is still the wrong thing.
